text_block_list.text:
As the autumn Tenno Sho draws closer,
Silence
Suzuka questions
Matikanefukukitaru about
whether she is
happy or not.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару answers that, thanks
to her
fans and I, she's very happy being
able to run her
heart out now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After that, she asks Сайленс Судзука the
exact
same question.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука answers that while she
isn't quite
happy yet, she has the feeling
it's almost within
reach.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thus, Матиканэфукукитару and Silence
Suzuka
move forward, each seeking their
own form of
happiness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
